passages.text: A new pupil brings a picture book written in the language she speaks at home. The class cannot read all the words, but the pictures give them a starting point. They place the book on a flat, smooth table and open it so that everyone can see the pages. The new pupil reads a short page aloud and explains what the main character wants. Other pupils compare the pictures with the explanation and ask about two unfamiliar words. By the end, they understand the little story and share something important to their new classmate.

parallelText.en: A new pupil brings a picture book written in the language she speaks at home.
parallelText.zh: 一位新同学带来一本用她在家说的语言写成的图画书。

parallelText.en: The class cannot read all the words, but the pictures give them a starting point.
parallelText.zh: 全班不能读懂所有文字，但图片为他们提供了切入点。

parallelText.en: They place the book on a flat, smooth table and open it so that everyone can see the pages.
parallelText.zh: 他们把书放在平整光滑的桌上，摊开书页，让大家都能看见。

parallelText.en: The new pupil reads a short page aloud and explains what the main character wants.
parallelText.zh: 新同学朗读一小页，并解释主角想要什么。

parallelText.en: Other pupils compare the pictures with the explanation and ask about two unfamiliar words.
parallelText.zh: 其他学生把图片和解释作对照，并询问两个不熟悉的词。

parallelText.en: By the end, they understand the little story and share something important to their new classmate.
parallelText.zh: 最后，他们理解了这个小故事，也分享了新同学重视的东西。

passages.text: Our nature group finds a small object beside a leaf on the garden path. At first it looks like a piece of bark, so we leave it where it is and look closely. Then it moves, and we notice six thin legs beneath its body. The teacher helps us recognise it as an insect rather than a piece of wood. We draw what we can see and write down the place and time of the observation. We do not take it away, because we want to observe it without disturbing its home.

parallelText.en: Our nature group finds a small object beside a leaf on the garden path.
parallelText.zh: 我们自然小组在花园小路的一片叶子旁发现一个小东西。

parallelText.en: At first it looks like a piece of bark, so we leave it where it is and look closely.
parallelText.zh: 起初它像一块树皮，所以我们让它留在原处并仔细观察。

parallelText.en: Then it moves, and we notice six thin legs beneath its body.
parallelText.zh: 随后它动了，我们发现它身体下面有六条细腿。

parallelText.en: The teacher helps us recognise it as an insect rather than a piece of wood.
parallelText.zh: 老师帮助我们认出它是一只昆虫，而不是木片。

parallelText.en: We draw what we can see and write down the place and time of the observation.
parallelText.zh: 我们画下看见的情况，记录观察地点和时间。

parallelText.en: We do not take it away, because we want to observe it without disturbing its home.
parallelText.zh: 我们没有把它带走，因为希望在不打扰它栖息地的情况下观察。

wordHelp.meaning: the outer covering of a tree
watching something carefully
interrupting or upsetting
